name: Evolve 3D [SNOW]
desc:
Now with land!

Currently in alpha, expect bugs.
Check out the community social links below to suggest new features and report bugs.

🔨 Mix parts for unique creatures with special abilities.
🗺️ Explore a vast 3D map filled with NPCs and players alike.
💻 NPCs have the same hunger and needs as players.
🤝 Choose peaceful, cooperative, or competitive gameplay.
🧬 Earn DNA through eating, fighting, helping others, or aging your creature.
💔 Careful with your life, you lose 1/10th of your creatures DNA when you die or leave without despawning
🧭 Longer survival means more DNA, allowing you to build larger and more powerful creatures.

Inspired by: https://www.roblox.com/games/14958096162/Evolve
